remarks: Lovely Mid Rise Complex (Carriage House) set back from the road on park-like setting. Over 1,000 sf of living space with 2 Bedrooms and 2 Full Baths. Living Room with gas fireplace and Dining Area. Good size kitchen. Stackable washer and dryer in closet off kitchen. Ensuite bath in Primary Bedroom with huge Walk-in closet and 2nd Bedroom plus hall bath. Central A/C, Gas Heat and cooking. Assigned Covered Shared Garage Parking with storage unit. Convenient location near I-95, Norwalk Community College, shopping, bus line, Costco, new Wegmans & Target. ALL INVESTORS WELCOME!!! Note: Photos were taken prior to current tenant occupancy.
